### 1 — Scene
A tray meal with cheese-and-tomato-topped filled pasta, sliced roast meat and roasted potatoes, mixed vegetables, fruit salad, and water. I include all four dishes on the tray. The bottle appears to contain sauce or dressing; its contents are too uncertain to quantify, so I exclude it.

### 2 — Vessels
Estimated outside diameters and areas:
- Pasta side plate: **20 cm**, **314 cm²**
- Meat-and-potato plate: **18 cm**, **254 cm²**
- Fruit bowl: **18 cm**, **254 cm²**
- Vegetable bowl: **20 cm**, **314 cm²**

### 3–7 — Items, coverage, volume, weight, and energy
Coverage percentages refer to each item's own vessel. Heights describe the food pile, not bowl depth. Sauce and cheese are included in the pasta’s plated energy density.

| Visible food | Vessel coverage | Area × height = gross volume | Density | Estimated grams | kcal/100 g | kcal |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Filled pasta with tomato sauce and melted cheese | 65% | 204 cm² × 1.4 cm = 286 ml | 0.9 | 257 | 180 | 463 |
| Sliced roast meat | 35% | 89 cm² × 1.2 cm = 107 ml | 0.95 | 102 | 220 | 224 |
| Roasted baby potatoes, including visible oily coating | 30% | 76 cm² × 1.5 cm = 114 ml | 0.9 | 103 | 140 | 144 |
| Mixed fruit pieces, including melon, pineapple and orange | 65% | 165 cm² × 2 cm = 330 ml | 0.6 | 198 | 50 | 99 |
| Mixed vegetables: carrots, corn, peas/beans and broccoli | 60% | 188 cm² × 1.7 cm = 320 ml | 0.6 | 192 | 55 | 106 |

**Coverage check:** pasta plate 65%; meat-and-potato plate 65% combined; fruit bowl 65%; vegetable bowl 60%. The remaining areas are exposed rims or gaps outside the food piles.

### 8 — Sanity check
The estimate is **852 g of food and approximately 1,036 kcal**, excluding water and the unidentified bottled contents. This is plausible for four substantially filled dishes. A reasonable uncertainty range is roughly **700–1,000 g and 850–1,250 kcal**, especially because the pasta filling and meat fat content are unclear.
